definition.proposition: Loop instability comes from an injection whose linearised transition has spectral radius ≥ 1 (additive: ρ = 1; concat-projection, like ours: unconstrained). A contractive diagonal A = exp(Δ·−exp(log A)) plus a prelude norm stabilises training, and test-time loss then saturates (L∞ + Z·e^{−zT}, plateau near µ_rec) instead of degrading
